SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / File No. 8718）
No. S. B. D. ____ / 38
Date August 22, 1938.

Subject Complaint Against P.W.D. Employee

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by [签名]

On August 17, 1938, Mr. D.E. HARBOTTLE of the
Cleansing Department of the Public Works Department
passed to this office the attached translation of a
communication received by the Council and solicited
Police assistance in ascertaining the identity of the
P.W.D. employee referred to.

Enquiries revealed that 52/876 Gordon Road,
until recently a bamboo bungalow, was occupied by one
KOO KE WONG ( 顧克黃 ) and his brother KOO KE SUNG
( 顧克遜 ), until its demolition some two months ago.
They at present reside at 814 Markham Road. They were
both questioned but knew nothing of the letter addressed
to the Council. They also intimated that nobody named
ZAO TSENG FU ( 曹正富 ) had even resided at 52/876
Gordon Road. They removed to their present address
on account of the fact that the land on which their
bungalow was situated was required by the landlords for
rebuilding purposes. Neither at any time have they had any
trouble with members of the P.W.D.

TSEU PU-ZENG ( 周浦成 ), alleged by the letter
to have attempted to extort money from hut dwellers, has
been identified as Coolie Foreman No.20 attached to the
P.W.D. Depot at 828 Markham Road.

During the investigation, nothing has come to
light that would in the slightest confirm the contents
of the attached communication.

D.C. (Special Branch).

D. S.
[签名: Da. Pitts]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特别股。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别股登记室 / 档案号 8718）
编号 S. B. D. ____ / 38
日期 1938年8月22日。

事由 针对工务局雇员的投诉

由 D.S. Pitts 提交 转呈人 [签名]

1938年8月17日，工务局清洁部的 D.E. HARBOTTLE 先生向本办公室转交了附上的工部局收到的一份信件的译文，并请求警方协助查明信中提及的工务局雇员的身份。

经查询得知，戈登路（Gordon Road）52/876号直至最近仍为一处竹制平房，由顾克黄（KOO KE WONG）及其兄弟顾克逊（KOO KE SUNG）居住，直到约两个月前该房屋被拆除。他们目前居住在马克姆路（Markham Road）814号。两人均接受了问询，但对致工部局的信件一无所知。他们还表示，从未有名为曹正富（ZAO TSENG FU）的人居住在戈登路52/876号。他们搬至现址是因为房东需要收回其平房所在的土地用于重建。他们从未与工务局成员发生过任何纠纷。

据信件指控曾试图向棚户居民勒索钱财的周浦成（TSEU PU-ZENG），已被确认为隶属于马克姆路828号工务局堆场的第20号苦力领班。

在调查过程中，未发现任何能哪怕 slightest 证实所附信件内容的事实。

副督察长（特别股）。

D. S.
[签名: Da. Pitts]

副本已送

G8/237

（印：PUBLIC WORKS DEPT. S.M.C. 1938 AUG 11）

Translation of Petition to Secretary from
Zao Tseng-fu and seven others.

Dated 8th August, 1938.

P.W.D. employ'e; Complaint against.

Tseu Pu-zeng is an employ'e at the Gordon Road Office
of the Public Works Department. We have twice reported to the
Council that he has collected money from us by fraudulent
misrepresentation and is deceiving his superiors, but as Tseu
is on good terms with his colleagues, no action has yet been
taken against him. He threatens to demolish our dwellings
unless we pay him some money, although our landlord has never
reported this matter to the Police. Without the knowledge of
the Council's officers he has brought with him several workmen
to pull down the houses in our lane, so that we will become
homeless and exposed to the weather. When we requested Tseu to
delay demolishing for a few days, he not only refused, but beat
with a strap those of us who had not paid him money. We cannot
tolerate this any longer. Will the Secretary kindly depute an
officer to investigate this matter as soon as possible and
dismiss Tseu pending punishment as a warning to others.

(Signed) Zao Tseng-fu and seven other
Petitioners.

Address: No. 52, Lane 576, Gordon Road.

(Note: Received for translation a.m. 10th August, 1938)

G8/237

（印：上海公共租界工部局工务局 1938年8月11日）

曹正富等八人致秘书请愿书的译文。

日期 1938年8月8日。

工务局雇员；被投诉人。

周浦成是工务局戈登路办事处的一名雇员。我们曾两次向工部局报告，他通过欺诈性虚假陈述向我们收取钱款，并欺骗其上级，但由于周与同事关系良好，迄今未对他采取任何行动。他威胁说，除非我们向他支付一些钱，否则将拆除我们的住房，尽管我们的房东从未就此事项向警方报案。他在工部局官员不知情的情况下，带领几名工人来拆除我们弄堂里的房屋，致使我们无家可归，暴露在风雨之中。当我们请求周推迟几天拆除时，他不仅拒绝，还用皮带殴打那些未向他付款的人。我们再也无法容忍这种行为。恳请秘书尽快委派一名官员调查此事，并在惩处之前先将周撤职，以儆效尤。

（签名）曹正富及其他七名
请愿人。

地址：戈登路576弄52号。

（注：于1938年8月10日上午收到以待翻译）
